Thief s1 + jump trick saving micro seconds. Recorded this few days back, not the most efficient run (can spam s4 during downtime), but just wanna show this trick saving a lot of time & being able to spam more rage during the run

Just to clarify with regards to the S1 Jump Cancel Trick : 
- The purpose of this is because whenever you cast S1, it moves you a considerable amount of distance. You will then have to waste that 0.5s PER S1 to get back within attacking range, and if you add those 0.5s up you'll easily lose a few free hits of damage. 
- There is no reason to do this if the monster is large in size and hence your S1 will almost never bring you out of range (i.e. perhaps Darkgoo, Seruf), or if you are aiming to hit multiple targets with S1.
Just jump whenever cast s1 that's it right
Must time properly

To add to performing the animation cancel, just note that doing [Jump -> S1] might not be as consistent as [S1 -> Jump] (Basically jump the moment you see S1 casted, indicating that you've used it and hence the jump cancel becomes more consistent in a sense)
It'll take awhile to grasp the timing but you'll get it after a few tries

The concept is that for [Jump -> S1] most of the time you're trying to jump when you see S1 cooldown ends, but sometimes there's skill animation from S4 and possibly Rage Skill (RS) which would hence cause a delay in S1 and hence your cancel becomes a normal double jump instead
Just a little point to note
If there's further theorycrafts that anyone discovers throughout this process do let me know, there's always more to learn together 👍
